scope: For each signed owner-scoped provenTxReq returned by the existing source query, replace its inputBEEF with complete public ancestor bytes from source storage only; remove the subject transaction. No network lookup, private foreign metadata or database mutation. Signed request wasBroadcast values use strict wire booleans (only SQL 0/1 or existing booleans admitted); invalid values reject. Shared request notification transactionIds are projected onto the requesting owner’s transaction rows, including same-owner subscriptions on other transaction rows; unknown or malformed IDs reject; other notification fields and the source database remain unchanged. An absent notification transactionIds property is preserved; all other notification fields remain byte-identical values. Rebuild only the signed subject’s reachable parent graph before removing the subject, excluding unrelated transaction entries in source batch BEEF.
pagination: Runs before the unchanged getSyncChunk item and rough-size accounting; retains since/order/offsets and existing at-most-one-final-row rough-size overflow semantics.
retirement: Remove when an admitted upstream release exports equivalent complete ancestry and passes all four descendant-funded replacement directions without this adapter.
